fields: as the router: cols (first is the situation column, the rest name the route's steps), rows (first cell the situation, each other cell a string or {t, link, intent}). A route whose cells link somewhere (the last link wins) is clickable as a whole through a pointer-only overlay; the real link stays the keyboard target, its intent rides on both. A value that opens with a [placeholder] is pending: dashed rule and "To confirm" (as Router). Best for 3 to 8 rows.
best_for: ManifoldRouter sets a router table as large type on a limestone sheet, every situation a branch off one manifold: the reader picks a situation, the water runs down to its branch and its route opens beside it.
